up: Retrieve IC50 activity data for dapagliflozin and its salt forms against the target sodium/glucose cotransporter 1. Include the following output columns: compound name, compound ChEMBL ID, target name, assay description, literature source title, literature year, and literature DOI. Join through the molecule hierarchy to include salt forms of dapagliflozin. Do not filter by confidence score or document type. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql:
WITH parent_compound AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE LOWER(pref_name) = 'dapagliflozin'
),
related_mols AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM parent_compound
  UNION
  SELECT mh.molregno
  FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
  JOIN parent_compound pc ON mh.parent_molregno = pc.molregno
)
SELECT
  md2.pref_name AS compound_name,
  md2.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  d.title AS literature_title,
  d.year AS literature_year,
  d.doi AS literature_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN related_mols rm ON rm.molregno = a.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md2 ON md2.molregno = rm.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = ass.doc_id
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND LOWER(td.pref_name) = 'sodium/glucose cotransporter 1'
